title: the_boyfriend_who_streamed_my_ban
display_title: My boyfriend got me permanently banned from my own parkour server — on purpose
share_line: Send this to anyone whose partner treats their hobby like a threat.
beats: My boyfriend of two years reported my own Minecraft account to get me banned from the server I helped build.
For eight months I'd been running a parkour course there, 40-some blocks of jumps I designed myself, and I was three days from finishing my personal best run.
He kept saying it was weird that a 31-year-old woman spent her nights doing this instead of watching movies with him.
I laughed it off until I logged in Tuesday and got a permanent ban screen instead.
Reason listed: 'griefing and account sharing,' reported by an admin account I didn't recognize.
Turns out he'd messaged the server owner, our mutual friend, claiming I'd let a stranger use my login to cheat.
The owner believed him immediately, because they'd been drinking together the night before.
My boyfriend told me afterward, completely calm, that he did it 'for us,' so I'd finally have time for real life.
I haven't unbanned myself from anything yet, and he still doesn't understand why I'm not talking to him. Was I wrong to pack a bag before I even finished yelling?
